prompt.en: Now predict for a fast bowler swinging the ball: can the bowler's coach ignore the seam and the air around the ball? Why?
prompt.hi: Ab socho fast bowler ki swing ke liye: kya coach seam aur ball ke aaspaas ki hawa ko ignore kar sakta hai? Kyon?

challenges.hint: Which details caused the effect you want to study?

prompt.en: Quick recall: does the same detail always have to be included in every model? Give a one-line reason.
prompt.hi: Jaldi yaad karo: kya ek hi detail har model mein hamesha daalni padti hai? Ek line mein reason do.

challenges.hint: Was the seam important both times?

prompt.en: Which statement is a complete measurement? (a) The rope is 12. (b) The rope is 12 m. (c) The rope is long. Explain.
prompt.hi: Kaunsa complete measurement hai? (a) Rassi 12 hai. (b) Rassi 12 m hai. (c) Rassi lambi hai. Samjhao.

prompt.en: From memory: how many seconds are in one hour, and how many grams in one kilogram?
prompt.hi: Yaad se batao: ek ghante mein kitne second, aur ek kilogram mein kitne gram?

prompt.en: Predict which word a scientist would use for 'objects in free fall near Earth speed up by about 9.8 m/s every second, every time': law, theory or hypothesis?
prompt.hi: Socho, scientist kaunsa shabd use karega 'Earth ke paas girti cheezein har second lagbhag 9.8 m/s tez hoti hain, har baar' ke liye: law, theory ya hypothesis?

prompt.en: One line: in science, does 'theory' mean a guess?
prompt.hi: Ek line: science mein 'theory' ka matlab guess hai kya?

prompt.en: Predict: human body cells have 46 chromosomes. How many will an egg or sperm cell have, and why must it be that number?
prompt.hi: Socho: insaan ki body cells mein 46 chromosomes hote hain. Egg ya sperm mein kitne honge, aur kyon wahi number hona chahiye?

challenges.hint: Two cells join: their chromosomes add

prompt.en: Are a bacterium, a single-celled Amoeba and a mango tree all covered by the cell theory? Explain in one line.
prompt.hi: Kya bacterium, single-cell Amoeba aur aam ka ped, sab cell theory mein aate hain? Ek line mein batao.

prompt.en: Can a muscle push? One word answer and one-line reason.
prompt.hi: Kya muscle dhakel sakti hai? Ek shabd aur ek line ka reason.

prompt.en: You walk 30 m east and then 30 m west along the same road. Find your distance and displacement.
prompt.hi: Tum 30 m east aur phir 30 m west usi sadak pe chalte ho. Distance aur displacement batao.

prompt.en: Predict before calculating: an auto goes 4 km north then 3 km east. Will the displacement be more than, equal to, or less than 7 km?
prompt.hi: Calculate karne se pehle socho: auto 4 km north phir 3 km east jaata hai. Displacement 7 km se zyada, barabar ya kam hoga?

challenges.hint: Is the straight line shorter than the bent path?

prompt.en: On a number line with your house at 0 and east positive, mark: shop at +300 m, temple at −200 m. What is the displacement from shop to temple?
prompt.hi: Number line pe ghar 0 aur east positive maano: dukaan +300 m, mandir −200 m. Dukaan se mandir tak displacement kya hai?

prompt.en: A scooter speeds up from rest to 15 m/s in 5 s. Find its acceleration.
prompt.hi: Ek scooter rest se 5 s mein 15 m/s tak tez hota hai. Acceleration batao.

prompt.en: Predict: when a ball thrown straight up reaches its highest point, is its acceleration zero, upward or downward? Then reason it out.
prompt.hi: Socho: jab seedhi upar phenki ball sabse oonche point pe hoti hai, uska acceleration zero hai, upar hai ya neeche?

prompt.en: Aditi uses s = ut + ½at² with u = 10 m/s, a = 2 m/s², t = 3 s and gets 33 m. Find her mistake.
prompt.hi: Aditi s = ut + ½at² mein u = 10 m/s, a = 2 m/s², t = 3 s daalti hai aur 33 m paati hai. Galti dhundho.

prompt.en: 10 g sugar is dissolved in 90 g water. Find the mass % of sugar.
prompt.hi: 10 g cheeni 90 g paani mein ghuli hai. Cheeni ka mass % nikalo.

prompt.en: Predict the reading: a beaker of 300 g water and 30 g sugar is on a balance; the sugar is stirred in completely. What does the balance show now?
prompt.hi: Socho reading: balance pe 300 g paani aur 30 g cheeni ka beaker; cheeni poori ghol di. Ab balance kya dikhayega?

challenges.hint: Dissolving spreads particles, does not destroy

prompt.en: Is fog a solution, colloid or suspension?
prompt.hi: Kohra solution, colloid ya suspension hai?

prompt.en: Predict: a carrom striker is flicked with the same push on (a) a carrom board with boric powder, (b) a rough wooden table. Which goes farther and why?
prompt.hi: Socho: carrom striker ko same zor se (a) boric powder waale carrom board pe, (b) khurdure lakdi ke table pe maara. Kaunsa zyada door jaayega aur kyon?

options.text: (a) a carrom board with boric powder
(b) a rough wooden table. Which goes farther and why

challenges.keyText: (a) a carrom board with boric powder

prompt.en: Rahul says, 'Two forces of 10 N and 6 N act on a box in opposite directions, so the net force is 16 N.' Correct him.
prompt.hi: Rahul kehta hai, 'Ek box pe 10 N aur 6 N opposite directions mein, toh net force 16 N.' Theek karo.

prompt.en: A 50 kg girl runs up 15 steps, each 20 cm high, in 6 s. Find her power. (g = 10 m/s²)
prompt.hi: 50 kg ki ladki 15 seedhiyan (har ek 20 cm oonchi) 6 s mein daudke chadhti hai. Power nikaalo. (g = 10 m/s²)

prompt.en: Predict: if the same girl walks up the same stairs slowly in 30 s, how do her work and power change?
prompt.hi: Socho: agar wahi ladki wahi seedhiyan dheere 30 s mein chadhe, toh work aur power kaise badlenge?

prompt.en: Predict: on a seesaw, a 30 kg child sits 2 m from the pivot. Where should a 40 kg child sit to balance?
prompt.hi: Socho: seesaw pe 30 kg ka bachcha pivot se 2 m door baitha hai. 40 kg ka bachcha kahan baithe ki balance ho?

prompt.en: Scientists have changed the atomic model at least four times. Does that mean science is unreliable? Explain using this history.
prompt.hi: Scientists ne atom ka model kam se kam chaar baar badla. Kya iska matlab science bharosemand nahi? Is history se samjhao.

challenges.hint: Was each change driven by evidence?

prompt.en: Predict: if an atom gains one proton in its nucleus, does it stay the same element?
prompt.hi: Socho: agar atom ke nucleus mein ek proton badh jaaye, kya woh same element rahega?

prompt.en: Write the nuclear notation for an atom with 13 protons and 14 neutrons.
prompt.hi: 13 protons aur 14 neutrons wale atom ka nuclear notation likho.

prompt.en: Predict: will argon (Z = 18) react easily with other elements? Use its electron distribution.
prompt.hi: Socho: kya argon (Z = 18) doosre elements se aasaani se react karega? Electron distribution use karo.

prompt.en: Predict: will carbon-12 and carbon-14 both burn in oxygen to form carbon dioxide?
prompt.hi: Socho: kya carbon-12 aur carbon-14 dono oxygen mein jalke carbon dioxide banaayenge?

challenges.hint: Do they have the same electrons?

prompt.en: 5.3 g of sodium carbonate reacts with 6.0 g of ethanoic acid to give 2.2 g carbon dioxide, 0.9 g water and some sodium ethanoate. Find the mass of sodium ethanoate.
prompt.hi: 5.3 g sodium carbonate 6.0 g ethanoic acid se react karke 2.2 g carbon dioxide, 0.9 g paani aur kuch sodium ethanoate banata hai. Sodium ethanoate ka mass nikaalo.

challenges.hint: Products must add to the same

prompt.en: Carbon dioxide always has carbon and oxygen in a 3 : 8 mass ratio. How much carbon is in 44 g of carbon dioxide?
prompt.hi: Carbon dioxide mein carbon aur oxygen hamesha 3 : 8 mass ratio mein hote hain. 44 g carbon dioxide mein kitna carbon hai?

prompt.en: Predict: if dry salt crystals are melted (at about 800 °C, in an industrial furnace), will the liquid conduct electricity?
prompt.hi: Socho: agar sookhe namak ke crystals ko pighlaaya jaaye (lagbhag 800 °C, factory furnace mein), kya liquid bijli conduct karega?

prompt.en: In ionic bonding, are electrons shared or transferred?
prompt.hi: Ionic bonding mein electrons share hote hain ya transfer?

prompt.en: Predict before working it out: will calcium (valency 2) and phosphate (PO₄³⁻, valency 3) combine 1:1? Then write the formula.
prompt.hi: Pehle socho: kya calcium (valency 2) aur phosphate (PO₄³⁻, valency 3) 1:1 mein milenge? Phir formula likho.

prompt.en: Find the formula unit mass of ammonium sulphate, (NH₄)₂SO₄. (N 14, H 1, S 32, O 16)
prompt.hi: Ammonium sulphate (NH₄)₂SO₄ ka formula unit mass nikaalo. (N 14, H 1, S 32, O 16)

prompt.en: What is the molecular mass of oxygen gas, O₂? (O = 16 u)
prompt.hi: Oxygen gas O₂ ka molecular mass kya hai? (O = 16 u)

prompt.en: Can sound travel through a vacuum?
prompt.hi: Kya sound vacuum mein travel kar sakti hai?

prompt.en: A student calculates sea depth from a SONAR echo of 4 s at 1500 m/s as 6000 m. Fix the mistake.
prompt.hi: Ek student 4 s ke SONAR echo aur 1500 m/s se samudra ki gehraai 6000 m nikaalta hai. Galti theek karo.

prompt.en: Predict: in a Class 7 class photo and the same class's Class 9 photo, will all students have grown the same amount? Why?
prompt.hi: Socho: Class 7 ki class photo aur usi class ki Class 9 photo mein, kya sab bachche barabar lambe hue honge? Kyon?

prompt.en: Predict: will a lion (Panthera leo) and a tiger (Panthera tigris) share more features with each other than a tiger shares with a house cat (Felis catus)?
prompt.hi: Socho: kya sher (Panthera leo) aur baagh (Panthera tigris) ek doosre se zyada features share karenge, bajaay baagh aur ghar ki billi (Felis catus) ke?

challenges.hint: Which level do tiger and cat share?
